"overall": "The psalm is faithful and mostly sayable, and the frame (vv.1, 4-6, 47-48) has the right simple nobility. The long narrative middle, however, leans on European enclisis after 'E' (salvou-os, provocaram-no, dominaram-nos), which makes it sound translated and, in vv.41-42, makes a Brazilian ear hear 'us' where the Latin says 'them'. A handful of calques and filler nouns (fazer conhecer, ter por nada, coisas, lugar, petição) could give way to plainer native idiom with no loss to the Latin.",
